profiles.title: Minimal
profiles.description: Lifecycle-safe output capability target for non-interactive or externally driven doors.
conformance_evidence_expectations: required operations have contract-level conformance evidence
normal exit and disconnect behavior are exercised

profiles.title: Interactive
profiles.description: Interactive capability target with terminal input and basic caller context.
conformance_evidence_expectations: required operations have contract-level conformance evidence
interactive input and disconnect behavior are exercised

profiles.title: Complete
profiles.description: Capability target requiring every current ODS Core and optional operation.
compatibility_expectations: all current canonical operations are available
canonical lifecycle and failure semantics are preserved
conformance_evidence_expectations: every required operation has contract-level conformance evidence
success, failure, unsupported, and lifecycle behavior are exercised
